verdict.rationale: Cloudflare API tokens can be scoped to specific resources and permission levels. For example, Zone DNS Read on a single zone lets the token read DNS only for that zone. The recommended Cloudflare MCP server lets users pick which permissions to grant an agent through OAuth, or accept a purpose-scoped user or account API token as a bearer token, and a live probe confirms the OAuth gating. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped tokens restrict agent actions as claimed, and evidence of token lifecycle controls (expiry, IP restrictions, revocation/rotation) for agent credentials.
